game.title: Call of Duty: Ghosts
game.blurb: First-person shooter from Infinity Ward (RAWG also lists Raven Software and Neversoft Entertainment), published by Activision, released 2013-11-05. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the campaign missions named in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: Ghost Stories to Legends Never Die
chapters.summary: The first six missions: Ghost Stories, Brave New World, No Man's Land, Struck Down, Homecoming and Legends Never Die, with their side feats.

chapters.title: Federation Day to Into the Deep
chapters.summary: Missions seven to twelve: Federation Day, Birds of Prey, The Hunted, Clockwork, Atlas Falls and Into the Deep. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: End of the Line to The Ghost Killer
chapters.summary: The last six missions: End of the Line, Sin City, All or Nothing, Severed Ties, Loki and The Ghost Killer. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Veteran and Rorke Files
chapters.summary: Finishing the campaign on Veteran and collecting all 18 Rorke files.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 7439); RAWG keeps "Onslaught" and "Invasion" as separate entries, and no achievement names them. Steam app 209160 (the base game) is used; the store list also has 255163, "Digital Hardened Edition". 0 of 40 Steam achievements are hidden and none cover multiplayer. API names LEVEL_1 to LEVEL_18 complete the eighteen named missions; each side feat (LEVEL_nA or nB) was put in the chapter of the mission with the same number, a reasoned guess where the description does not name the mission. The groupings of six missions are our own choice. StrategyWiki has the guide at completion stage 0 (in Category:Pages needing subpaging): the main page itself is long (about 14,000 characters), but only Controls and Table of Contents subpages exist; Gameplay and Walkthrough are linked but not written. callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Ghosts" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
